decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Variation of wording of condition 25 (ferry landing stage) to read:
'Details of the landing stage for the ferry and means of pedestrian access to and from the landing stage to the mainland and details of screening of the inter-tidal muds on the landing stage shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. A timetable for the implementation of the landing stage shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the LPA prior to construction of building D on Ferry wharf.  The construction of the landing stage and pedestrian access shall be implemented in accordance with the approved details and shall be available for use by the public in accordance with a timetable to be agreed in writing with the LPA and to be permanently retained thereafter.
description: Following approval for demolition of existing and redevelopment of site for mixed commercial/residential use part details submitted pursuant to Condition 25 (ferry landing stage)- variation of wording of approved permission reference number 00443/G/P3 dated 06/07/1999.
